$comment: R315 · Task 1-c (agent J2) — the DOM-geometry judge's role-pairing table.
Every structural element of the Heron reference is paired with its Madarek
counterpart: heron.sel ↔ madarek.sel, plus the properties the judge compares.
LANGUAGE-FREE by construction: geometry + paint only, no text is ever compared.
Sites/pages:
landing  — https://heronaiapp.com/            ↔ http://localhost:5173/
contact  — https://heronaiapp.com/contact-us  ↔ http://localhost:5173/auth     (the /auth sheet template)
nf       — https://heronaiapp.com/r315-missing-page (real 404) ↔ http://localhost:5173/r315-missing-page
Side spec fields: sel (CSS; querySelectorAll), nth (1-based index into the match list,
default 1), agg:'union' (bounding box over ALL matches, display:none skipped),
pseudo:'::before' (box derived from the parent rect + resolved inset; paint from the
pseudo's own computed style).
Heron selectors verified against _local/heron-dom/*.json (E-crawl 24/24 dumps) and
the live site; Madarek selectors verified live at http://localhost:5173/ (probe in
_local/dom-judge/, all present). Selectors are Live-DOM CSS — the judge reports a
role as `missing` rather than guessing when a selector no longer matches.
Mirroring: Heron is LTR, Madarek RTL. The judge mirrors HERON's x-axis only:
mirrored_x = 1 − (x + w)/vw, and swaps left↔right border sides. Madarek geometry
is measured as-is (its RTL flow already seats it in the mirrored position).
Inline-start reads (bisw/bisc) on Madarek are the physical RIGHT edge under RTL —
which is exactly Heron's physical LEFT separator after mirroring.

tolerances.$box: x/w: |Δpx| ≤ 1% of viewport WIDTH; y/h: |Δpx| ≤ 1% of viewport HEIGHT (y in document coordinates for in-flow elements — scroll-independent; viewport coordinates for position:fixed elements).
tolerances.$stroke: border widths (all 4 sides) and shadow lengths: ±0.5px.
tolerances.$color: colors exact, with a perceptual allowance of ±2/255 per r/g/b channel — inherited from the r313 JPEG-era comparisons (anti-aliasing + color-profile rounding, e.g. #282828 vs #28282A must not file a ticket). Alpha (the rgba transparency Heron's 72% inks use): ±0.05.
tolerances.$fontSize: font-size ±2px: both sites drive fluid/stepped ladders that hit the same rung within rounding (46.67 vs 46, 13.33 vs 13); 2px is the sub-rung noise floor. line-height ±2px. font-weight EXACT.
tolerances.$letterSpacing: letter-spacing is deliberately NOT compared: the reference's Latin mono tracking cannot apply to Arabic cursive (the repo canon bans it).

severity.$doc: Ranking units for the worst-first list (comparable 'screen-size' fractions):
severity.visibility: 0.8 (one side paints, the other does not)

groups.$doc: groups are the CLI filter units (--roles header / --groups hero). Core groups (run at every viewport by default): chrome, header, hero, consent, footer. Full-matrix groups (1440x900 + 390x844 by default): + sections, auth, nf.
